summary: Iteration 3 — Smart math engine upgrade — Backend 33/33 pytest cases pass (8 new + 25 regression). Frontend mobile flow verified end-to-end: artisan login → project → measure wizard step1 (material) → step2 (new 'Hauteur sous plafond trémie' optional field rendered, testID input-hauteur-plafond-tremie) → step3 result card displays Quart-tournant shape, échappée critique alert (1200<2000), KPI grid with 'g (foulée)' label (280), Limon featured card (5048 mm, Vert Pomme), ligne de foulée note, SVG sketch with Limon label. Numerical correctness confirmed: limon≈5048mm = sqrt(2800²+4200²); échappée=1200mm = 2600-(8*175). Integration endpoint exposes limon_length_mm, echappee_mm, echappee_critique, is_tournant. PDF & DXF exports succeed; DXF contains 'LIMON' and 'Echappee' text annotations.

ui_bugs.issue: The optional 'Hauteur sous plafond au niveau de la trémie (mm)' Field was declared in state (hauteurPlafondTremie) and wired into the payload, but was NOT rendered. Test agent added the missing <Field testID='input-hauteur-plafond-tremie'/> between Reculement and Remarques. Also cleaned up a duplicate/garbled StyleSheet trailer (orphan 'utton, color: C.WHITE,...' lines 430-433) that was causing a Metro SyntaxError. After fix, full wizard works.
ui_bugs.priority: HIGH (was blocking the entire échappée UX)

critical_code_review_comments: compute_stair() is well-structured: hard rules (h≤210, g≥230, 560≤2h+g≤670) properly enforce tournant/hélicoïdal fallback. Échappée formula uses floor(x_tremie_start/g) which is the correct discrete step count under the slab.
limon_length is exposed both as 'hypotenuse' (back-compat) and 'limon_length'. Integration endpoint exposes both. Good.
DXF: LIMON line is drawn TWICE (once as HYPOTENUSE line, once as LIMON line) which overlaps but is acceptable; could be optimized.
server.py is now ~1100 lines — still single-file. Recommend modularization (calc engine, exports, auth) in a later iteration.
